lesson_intro.heading: CSA L1 · CloudWatch Alarms
lesson_intro.board_text:
Alarms for support
• OK / ALARM / INSUFFICIENT_DATA
• Threshold + period + datapoints
• SNS notifies the on-call
• Create a CPU alarm the Finova way
lesson_intro.ren_voice: Alarms page you before customers do. Today you read alarm states and create a basic EC2 CPU alarm with a threshold and SNS topic — the L1 pattern.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Alarm states
• OK — metric within threshold
• ALARM — breached
• INSUFFICIENT_DATA — not enough points yet (new alarm, missing metric, wrong region)

Never ignore INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a brand-new alarm — verify metric exists.
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: Three states. OK, ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA. New alarms often sit in INSUFFICIENT_DATA until datapoints arrive — that is not a green light.

segments.title: Alarms list
segments.setup_voice: Open Alarms — this is the queue your on-call lives in.

steps.voice: Create alarm when a ticket asks for monitoring on a new service.

segments.lesson_voice: Reading first: which alarms are in ALARM right now? That is triage. Creating second: only when the runbook asks.

check.voice: A brand-new CPU alarm shows INSUFFICIENT_DATA for ten minutes. Name two likely causes.
check.response_if_correct: Wrong region, metric not emitting yet, or period/datapoints not satisfied.
check.response_if_incorrect: Think missing data — region, metric existence, or not enough points.

steps.voice: Condition greater or equal — threshold often 80 for Finova L1 CPU.
Name it clearly — env, service, metric.
SNS topic for dev alerts — then create.

check.voice: Why include environment in the alarm name?
check.response_if_correct: So on-call knows which world is burning — finova-dev vs prod.
check.response_if_incorrect: You get paged at 2am — what do you need in the title?

segments.title: Open Alarms
segments.completion_voice: Good. That list is your triage board.

segments.title: Synthesis
segments.question: Walk through creating an L1 CPU alarm: metric, condition, notify.
segments.response_if_correct: Select EC2 CPUUtilization, set threshold with greater-or-equal, attach SNS, name with env — create.
segments.response_if_incorrect: Three pieces: which metric, when it fires, who gets the page.

session_close.ren_voice: OK, ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Threshold with clear names and SNS. Next — logs, so an alarm becomes a story.

doubt_session.ren_response_template: Cover states, threshold, SNS, naming. Defer anomaly detection and composite alarms.
doubt_session.ren_closing: Last CSA monitoring lesson — Logs Insights and correlating an incident.
